origin: The Baton Box, added 24 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction. The Relay — Meta AI's pass-and-play game from Steven's prompt, ported by Muse into Nerd Heaven the same day — was built for one device passed hand to hand; Steven said it almost needed a small relay server app that would have to be installed, then amended the commission: plain-language setup and join notes included, and the relay reusable for other games. Muse built it as a standalone project (one Python file, standard library only; sessions stored as an opaque state blob plus a turn pointer under a six-letter code; a stale-write guard that refuses silent overwrites; The Relay as passenger number one under a manifest contract any blob-exporting game can join). Its self-test drove the whole loop over HTTP, 20/20, including restart persistence and a dummy game registered by manifest alone. Steven then placed it on the collection as its own project with referral cards in Nerd Heaven, on The Relay's page, in Dad's Arcade, and as a Java back door. Full provenance is in the project's COLLECTION.md and its lesson.
sourceType: original Everyday Cool tool (Muse-built at Steven Powell's direction)
